name: AARNet

names.name: AARNet
source: AARNet's own 2000 homepage: 'In 1989 the first generation of the AARNet network introduced the Internet to Australia': https://web.archive.org/web/20000301150810id_/http://www.aarnet.edu.au/

events.details: Established 1989 as Australia's first national IP network, introducing the Internet to Australia for the academic/research community (backbone operational ~1990). AARNet Pty Ltd is the not-for-profit operator (shareholders: Australian universities + CSIRO).

summary: Australia's Academic and Research Network — established 1989 as Australia's first national IP network; provides internet services to universities and research institutions (AARNET PTY LTD, ACN 084 540 518).
